thread:
anna: Quick check-in on the DR postmortem follow-ups. We need concrete owners, minimal acceptance criteria, and a short plan to avoid the same patterns repeating.
kevin: I'll own the multi-region routing verification and the flip automation. Deliverable: script + perf graph + brief README. Target: sandbox run by Tuesday.
maya: I'll take backups + restore runbook updates and the IAM checklist. Plan: run one restorative test in staging and publish exact steps.
lee: I'll coordinate the game-day dry run and on-call handover. Suggest Thu 07:30 PT to cover EU overlap.
sam: I'll help instrument KV-cache checks and add a short validation job that runs post-failover. Proposed acceptance: sample 10 keys, fail if miss rate > 6% for 10m.
kevin: For routing tests: 3 modes — region outage, AZ networking blip, and slow peering. I'll include a `--dry-run` and `--execute` flag and capture RTO/RPO.
maya: Restore smoke steps I'll paste here (short):
```
- confirm latest snapshots: `gcloud compute snapshots list --filter="labels.env=prod" --limit=1`
- provision dr namespace: `kubectl --context=dr-test create ns dr-smoke`
- restore DB: `pg_restore --dbname=dr_test_db latest.dump`
- smoke check: `curl -fsS http://dr-smoke.app/healthz`
- data-sample verify: `python tools/compare_samples.py --count 5`
```
lee: Add explicit IAM names and a pre-test role check so volunteers don't get blocked. Also add a pre-window announce to #incidents 24h prior.
anna: Owners & deadlines:
- routing verification & script -> kevin -> due 2170600000
- backups + runbook + IAM checklist -> maya -> due 2170455000
- game-day dry run + invites -> lee -> due 2170368000
- cache validation job + threshold -> sam -> due 2170422000
- post-dry-run retro doc -> anna/all -> due 2170700000
sam: I'll make the cache job report to ops-bot and emit a short summary artifact on completion.
ops-bot: reminder: tag artifacts with `incident:DR-2026` and post logs/graphs to the incident tracker.
kevin: Note recurring issue: partial KV-cache invalidation seen twice in past 6 months. We'll add a post-flip rehydration step and a measured warm-up window in the runbook.
maya: Found one anomaly: a DR project had a 14-day retention by mistake. I'll open a ticket to extend redwood-prod retention to 90 days and add daily incremental deltas.
lee: I'll lock the dry-run time after confirming EU SRE availability and send invites. Also will coordinate a short run-of-show doc for volunteers.
anna: Two guardrails to add to runbook: 1) explicit abort thresholds (error-rate >20% or DB checksum mismatch >0); 2) clear owner to escalate if thresholds hit.
kevin: I'll attach the first sandbox run artifacts once I execute. Expect a short CSV of timings + a perf graph.
maya: I'll publish the runbook PR as draft tonight and request reviews from SRE and DB.
anna: Thanks team — goal is a repeatable playbook, measurable metrics, and clear owners. I'll create the action-tracker card and ping everyone on the card. :thumbsup:
